title: Ruleset: poop_piles
description: rules/<id>/poop_piles.yaml: how the field shows the partner's poop piles (apps/session: PoopAdapter).

look.description: How a pile is drawn (partner_impl.c: initializePoop, renderPoop).

model.description: The asset id of the pile's model.

model_size.description: The pile size drawn at the model's own scale; other sizes in proportion.

wild.description: The scene of a pile on the field (partner.c: tickWildPoop); without it the pile appears at once.

squat_clip.description: The partner's clip while it goes.

after_clip.description: The partner's clip after it went.

eat.description: How the partners that eat piles find and eat one (tickPoopDetection, partnerTickEatShit); without it none is eaten.

large_from.description: The size from which a pile is found from farther.

small_reach.description: How near the player must be to a smaller pile, on x and on z.

large_reach.description: The same for a larger pile.

eat_clip.description: The partner's clip while it eats.
